# Hostility frequency by danger band

<!-- GENERATED by `python3 -m worldgen.hostility_frequency`. Do not hand-edit. -->

Places only (roaming creatures and encounter sockets are Phase 13 and add to every band). A hostile place counts when it is hostile on arrival, clearable, or a dungeon-like interior; "met" = within 300 m of the route. Morrowind yardstick: ≈ 15 hostile places / km² of land and a fight every ≈ 350 m of road (docs/research/morrowind-content-density.md §1–2).
